content.text: My spider sense is telling me something’s up. I hope you’re well. I am very conscious of not speculating about injuries, especially in this situation and especially with you, so I want you to know that you can talk to me confidentially. I texted you earlier because I haven’t seen you yet and I thought it was weird. I am going poke around about this but if I put anything out publicly about you in this regard, I will follow up with you first. Again, hope you’re well.

Sorry bro. I just got done throwing. I hope you keep it between us Bc I haven’t told anyone but Boyd and my parents but I had it. Little over 2 weeks ago. Got my first negative test today so hoping to be back in a day or so
OK. I appreciate you getting back to me and I appreciate the trust in sharing that. I’m not going to poke around about it anymore. Glad you’re feeling better
All good man. No worries. I’ve felt 100% for over a week but it was gnarly for the first week
Woke up every night dripping sweat off my fingertips
That sucks real bad. When did you realize you had it
